official_alert.headline: Southbound Faregate Entrance Closed
official_alert.description: The southbound faregate entrance at Broad-Girard Station is closed until further notice. Passengers may access the platform through the faregates on the northbound side.

official_alert.headline: Sunday Schedule in Effect for Thanksgiving Day
official_alert.description: Bus, Metro and Regional Rail routes operate on a Sunday schedule on Thanksgiving Day. Routes that do not have Sunday schedules do not operate. All modes resume regular weekday schedule at the start of service day, Friday, November 27.

official_alert.headline: Shuttle Busing Between Olney and Fern Rock Transit Center
official_alert.description: B3 trains will operate only between 8th-Market and Erie Stations, and bus service replaces trains between Olney and Fern Rock Transit Center for the entire service day on Saturday, November 14 due to construction. Passengers may transfer to any B1 train at Erie Station to make their connection.
